text.card: A red giant 5,077 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.79 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,124 K at its surface.
